leagues.name: World Rugby events (Men's Rugby World Cup 2027 + HSBC SVNS 2026-27)
notes: Governing-body shape, modelled like FIFA/ICC: one partner list covering World Rugby's properties in the 2026-27 window - Men's Rugby World Cup 2027 (Australia, 1 Oct - 13 Nov 2027, 24 teams) and the HSBC SVNS Series and World Championship 2026-27 (nine events, 28 Nov 2026 - 30 May 2027).
World Rugby partner tiers (world.rugby header/footer, fetched 2026-09-25): Platinum Partner Emirates; Global Partners Macron, HSBC, WizTeam.

RWC 2027 partner tiers (rugbyworldcup.com/2027/en/partners, fetched 2026-09-25): Principal Partners Emirates, Asahi Super Dry, Visa; Official Partners LIQUI MOLY, Coca-Cola, IHG Hotels & Resorts; Official Suppliers & Supporters Dove Men+Care, Gilbert, Macron, LipovitanD (Taisho Pharmaceutical), Mitsubishi Estate, Meiji, Fanatics, Ticketmaster, ChildFund Rugby. Footer also shows Tourism Australia and the NSW, Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia and Victoria governments as host destination partners.

HSBC SVNS 2026-27 (world.rugby/news/1045878, 28 Jul 2026): Dubai 28-29 Nov, Cape Town 5-6 Dec, Singapore 30-31 Jan 2027, Perth 6-7 Feb, Vancouver 6-7 Mar, New York 13-14 Mar; World Championship: Hong Kong 9-11 Apr, Valladolid 21-23 May, Bordeaux 28-30 May 2027.

The World Rugby Nations Championship (inaugural 2026, finals at Twickenham; 2028 finals in Doha) is a separate World Rugby property. Its reported Qatar Airways title sponsorship (GBP 80m, eight years to 2034) was agreed but unsigned as of 25 Jun 2026 and paused amid Middle East tensions; no World Rugby announcement confirming it had been published as of 25 Sep 2026, so it is recorded in unsourced, not as a deal.
RWC 2027 team-level shirt sponsors of the 24 national unions are not yet in this file (each union must be checked separately); verified union partner lists for three unions are recorded in unsourced.

why.text: Dubai is part of the United Arab Emirates, where criticising the government can land you in prison. In 2024, 43 activists got life sentences in a single mass trial. Putting Emirates on a famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That's called sportswashing.

proposedRatings.reasoning: Already rated serious and the rating carries over: Emirates is owned by the Government of Dubai through Investment Corporation of Dubai, and the UAE mass-trial claims (43 life sentences in 2024, upheld in 2025) attach to that owner chain. As World Rugby's Platinum Partner through 2035, Principal Partner of RWC 2027/2029, brand-on-match-officials partner and title of the Dubai SVNS opener, the sportswashing logic is the same as on a club shirt - the sponsorship reaches every Rugby World Cup fan in the window.

Already rated serious: the state-owned flag carrier's reported GBP 80m Nations Championship title deal was agreed but unsigned/paused as of Jun 2026, so no deal is written; if formalised by November 2026 as SportsPro reports, the existing Qatar state-ownership and migrant-labour record claims attach unchanged.

Dubal Holding states on its own site that it is 'a subsidiary of Investment Corporation of Dubai', the Dubai government's investment arm, and it is a Platinum Partner of the Emirates Dubai 7s. Dubai state money in the UAE mass-trial context -> serious.

dnata sits in the Emirates Group (listed among the group's brands on theemiratesgroup.com), whose airline is owned by the Government of Dubai via ICD; a Platinum Partner of the Dubai SVNS opener. Dubai state money in the UAE mass-trial context -> serious.

HSBC Holdings plc is a publicly listed bank (London/Hong Kong/NYC listings; no state shareholder disclosed on hsbc.com) and the title partner of the whole SVNS Series - the brand runs across every event in the window. No state link found this pass -> none, pending a person's review.

Asahi Super Dry is a brand of Tokyo-listed Asahi Group Holdings (group business page lists SUPER DRY in its Europe and Asia Pacific portfolios); RWC Principal Partner and Official Beer until 2029. Private Japanese corporation, no sovereign stake found -> none.
IHG Hotels & Resorts is the brand of InterContinental Hotels Group PLC, a UK-listed hotel company (ihgplc.com). Listed company, no state ownership identified -> none.
The match-ball brand runs under Grays of Cambridge (gilbertrugby.com footer), a private UK sporting-goods company. No state link -> none.
Already rated none: Visa Inc. is a listed US payments company with no state stake; as RWC Principal Partner for 2027/2029 the same rating carries over.
Already rated concern (KfW state-bank stake in DHL Group); carries over to DHL's Platinum Partner role at the Emirates Dubai 7s, the only placement found for it in this window.

EVENT-HOST SHAPE - the 2027 series serves as part of qualification toward the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games (world.rugby/news/1045878); World Rugby confirmed the LA28 qualification pathway on 9 Sep 2026 (svns.com news 1046251, headline seen, article not opened).

EVENT-HOST SHAPE - Men's Rugby World Cup 2027 runs 1 Oct - 13 Nov 2027 across seven Australian host cities; tickets went on general sale 1 Oct 2026, one year before the opening match (world.rugby/news/1046827). Host destination partners shown in the RWC 2027 partners-page footer without a tier label: Tourism Australia and the New South Wales, Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia and Victorian governments (rugbyworldcup.com/2027/en/partners, fetched 2026-09-25).

EVENT-HOST SHAPE - World Rugby Nations Championship: SportsPro (25 Jun 2026, citing The Guardian) reported an agreed but unsigned GBP 80m (USD 105.36m) eight-year Qatar Airways title sponsorship running to 2034, paused because Qatari government figures felt it 'inappropriate' to announce amid regional tension after US military action against Iran; formalisation was expected by November 2026 and autumn 2026 rounds would run without Qatar Airways branding. As of 25 Sep 2026 no World Rugby announcement confirming the deal had been published; re-check status before publication. 2026 finals at Twickenham; 2028 finals in Doha (option for 2032).

EVENT-HOST SHAPE - Emirates Dubai 7s 2026 edition runs 27-29 Nov 2026 at The Sevens Stadium ('For the third consecutive year, ticket prices remain fixed... AED 75 Friday entry'; emiratesdubai7s.com/news/dubai-7s-2026-tickets-on-sale-now/, published 31 Aug 2026). The event-site partner strip (2025 date-announcement page) lists: HSBC (SVNS Title Partner), Dulsco and Dubai Holding (Presenting Partners), Dnata, mmi, DHL, IHG and Dubal Holding (Platinum Partners). Whether the same local-partner strip carries to the 2026 edition was not re-verified.

Team-level shirt sponsors of the 24 RWC 2027 unions were not collected this pass; the three union partner lists below were verified but shirt placements were not stated on the pages opened, so no kits were written.

New Zealand Rugby partners (allblacks.com/partners, fetched 2026-09-25): Altrad 'Major Global Partner'; Adidas, Gallagher Insurance, Toyota 'Official Platinum Partner'; Bupa, Taisho Pharmaceutical, TUDOR, Xero 'Global Partners'; regional partners 2degrees, Mitsui Fudosan, Steinlager, Ray White; suppliers include Gilbert, Cadbury, Powerade, Rexona (Unilever), YETI, STATSports. Adidas is the All Blacks kit supplier (allblacks.com shop links) but placement/term not stated.

South Africa Rugby (springboks.rugby/partners, fetched 2026-09-25): Principal Partners FNB, Pick n Pay, Coca-Cola, Betway, Nike, Castle; Official Partners Vodacom, SuperSport, FlySafair, Monster, Hyundai, Southern Sun, Samsung; Official Sponsors Engen, Rhino, Unilever, Spur, AfriSam, Freddy Hirsch, Klipdrift; Official Supporters Bluu, Biogen, STATSports, Virgin Active, Oakley, Stadio, Springbok Atlas, Outsurance, Leukoplast. Nike is the Springboks on-field kit brand (springboks.rugby shop links 'Nike Official Springbok Gear') but front-of-shirt placement was not stated.

England Rugby (englandrugby.com homepage, fetched 2026-09-25): O2 appears as the header sponsor logo ('header-sponsor-logo') and Castore as kit supplier (header logos); neither page opened stated the shirt placement or term. englandrugby.com/partnerships and O2's sponsorship pages returned 403/404 to automated fetches.

LIQUI MOLY ownership: widely reported as part of the Würth Group (acquired 2018), but neither wuerth.com (JS-only directory) nor liqui-moly.com stated it on the pages fetched this pass (liqui-moly.com/en/gb/company/about-us.html fetched OK but contains no ownership statement). No owner record written; needs a primary statement (e.g. Würth Group annual report) before setting an ownerId.

Ticketmaster ownership: the RWC partner page names 'Ticketmaster Sport' as Official Supplier; ticketmaster.com's footer 'Our Network' lists Live Nation, House of Blues etc., and livenationentertainment.com links its Ticketing section to business.ticketmaster.com, but no explicit 'Ticketmaster is a Live Nation Entertainment company' statement was opened this pass. ownerId live-nation-entertainment written on that basis; confirm via Live Nation's 10-K segment description.

Dubai Holding ownership: dubaiholding.com/en/who-we-are describes a 2004 mandate 'supporting the government's long-term vision' but does not state the owner; widely described as a Dubai sovereign investment vehicle - needs a primary statement before setting an ownerId.
Dulsco ownership: dulsco.com/en/about-us traces the group to 1935 but states no owner. No ownerId set.

WizTeam is 'Swiss based, with head offices in the heart of the Olympic Capital Lausanne' with subsidiaries in Australia, Belgium, Italy and Ukraine (wiz-team.com/about); founder ownership details not stated.

Dove Men+Care is a Unilever brand per common knowledge; the RWC partner page calls it the 'Official Body Care Supplier of Rugby World Cup 2027' without naming the parent. The normalized Unilever sponsor entry carries no ownerId, so none was set here; Unilever's corporate statement would settle it.

Emirates' original RWC sponsorship dates: World Rugby's 2025 renewal release says the partnership dates 'to 1987 (title sponsor of the Dubai Rugby Sevens) and to 2007 as an official Rugby World Cup sponsor'; the deal in force before the 2025 extension and its value were not stated.
No commercial values for any World Rugby, RWC 2027 or SVNS partnership were public in the sources fetched; deal values are null throughout.
The RWC 2027 partners page spells 'Mistubishi Estate' (sic); the sponsor record uses the standard spelling Mitsubishi Estate.

Source conflict, minor: the SVNS schedule article shows World Rugby's tier structure as 'Platinum Partner' (Emirates) plus 'Global Partners' (Macron, HSBC, WizTeam) while rugbyworldcup.com uses 'Principal Partners' (Emirates, Asahi Super Dry, Visa) / 'Official Partners' / 'Official Suppliers & Supporters' - different properties use different tier names; both captured as fetched.
Rugby Australia / Wallabies partner pages were not verifiable this pass (rugbyaustralia.com.au returned 429 to automated fetch), so Australia's team sponsors are unrecorded.
